identification: Chromolithograph 'Plate LXIII Marsupialia' from Johnson's Household Book of Nature (Henry J. Johnson, New York, c1880), image c.6.5 x 8.25 in, in bird's-eye maple frame with wide buff mat; Lahaina Printsellers Ltd (Maui, Hawaii) certificate of authenticity. Shows tree kangaroo, myrmecobius, wombat, koala, kangaroo, phalanger, Tasmanian devil and a thylacine (Tasmanian tiger).
